meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 在你的 macOS 菜单栏加一个闪电图标:绿点表示 NanoClaw 正在运行,红点表示已停止,点开可启动、停止、重启服务。它会编译一个 Swift 二进制并通过 launchd 常驻运行。
howto.when: 当你在 macOS 上要求给 NanoClaw 添加菜单栏状态图标时触发;非 macOS 或找不到 swiftc 时它会停下并给出安装提示。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 装一个 macOS 菜单栏状态图标
say.note: 会编译二进制并用 launchctl 注册为常驻服务

say.text: 确认一下 NanoClaw 的菜单栏状态图标装好了没有
say.note: 用 launchctl list 检查是否有 PID

say.text: 怎么卸载 NanoClaw 的菜单栏状态图标
say.note: 按技能里的 REMOVE.md 步骤操作

howto.what_en: Adds a macOS menu bar bolt icon for NanoClaw: green dot means running, red dot means stopped, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. It compiles a Swift binary and loads it via launchd.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add the NanoClaw menu bar status indicator on macOS. It stops with install hints if you are not on macOS or swiftc is missing.

say_en.text: Add a macOS menu bar status icon for NanoClaw
say_en.note: Compiles the binary and registers it via launchctl

say_en.text: Check whether the NanoClaw menu bar icon is installed
say_en.note: Uses launchctl list to look for a PID

say_en.text: How do I uninstall the NanoClaw menu bar icon?
say_en.note: Follows the REMOVE.md steps in the skill
